resources.string: Turn your phone into a Bluetooth keyboard for PowerPoint on Windows. No internet. No laptop app. Just your presentation.
Requires compatible Bluetooth HID firmware. Keep SlidePilot open and the phone unlocked while presenting. Pairing alone does not mean connected.
Volume up = next • Volume down = previous. Only while this screen is active; some phone firmware intercepts these keys.
Keep PowerPoint focused on your laptop. The timer is local and does not read the slideshow.
This resets your local timer to zero. It does not change the presentation.
Send Escape to the selected laptop.
Allow Nearby Devices to register the Bluetooth keyboard and connect to a paired laptop. No location or internet permission is used.
Nearby Devices permission is off. Tap Allow to try again, or enable it in App settings if Android no longer shows the prompt.
This device has no available Bluetooth adapter.
Turn on Bluetooth to check HID support and connect to your laptop.
Checking the HID Device profile and waiting for Android to confirm keyboard registration…
Android did not provide the HID Device service in time. Retry after restarting Bluetooth. If this persists, the firmware may not support this profile.
The firmware did not expose the Bluetooth HID Device profile. Retry after restarting Bluetooth; this phone may not support keyboard mode.
Android did not confirm HID registration within 10 seconds. Keep this screen open, close other Bluetooth remote apps, and retry.
Android unregistered the HID keyboard. Keep SlidePilot in the foreground and tap Check / retry HID.
The Bluetooth HID service disconnected. Check Bluetooth, then retry HID registration.
No paired devices found. Pair your Windows laptop first, then select it here.
HID keyboard registration confirmed. Select your paired Windows laptop and tap Connect.
Waiting for the laptop to confirm a Bluetooth HID connection…
HID connection confirmed. Keep PowerPoint focused and this screen open.
The laptop did not connect within 20 seconds. Check Windows Bluetooth, return here, retry HID, then reconnect.

The laptop did not open the keyboard connection. On the laptop, remove this phone from Bluetooth devices, then tap Pair here and pair again. You can also tap the phone on the laptop and press Connect.
Remote disconnected. Retry HID if needed, then reconnect to your selected laptop.
The laptop removed the HID virtual cable. Check pairing on both devices and connect again.
Android could not send the keyboard report. The session was closed. Reconnect before continuing.
Key release could not be submitted after retries. The connection was closed to stop further commands. Check the laptop and reconnect.
The Bluetooth service returned an error. Restart Bluetooth and retry. Diagnostics records the error type.
Wait for HID registration before pairing. Tap Check / retry HID if needed.
No paired devices yet. Use Pair a new laptop or Bluetooth settings, then return here.

1. Keep SlidePilot open and tap Make discoverable.

2. On Windows 11: Settings → Bluetooth & devices → Add device → Bluetooth. On Windows 10: Settings → Devices → Bluetooth & other devices → Add Bluetooth or other device.

3. Select this phone (Windows may show its Bluetooth name), then confirm matching pairing codes on both devices.

4. Return to SlidePilot, choose the laptop, and tap Connect. Wait for Connected before using controls.

If Android asks you to type a pairing code using a keyboard, cancel and pair from Android Bluetooth settings instead, then return here and retry HID.
Phone discoverable temporarily. Add this phone from Windows now; keep SlidePilot open.
Discoverability was cancelled. You can retry or pair through Bluetooth settings.
Allow Nearby Devices advertising to make this phone discoverable. Existing paired connections do not require advertising.
This phone could not open that system screen. Open Bluetooth settings manually.

• Connect your laptop to the projector and open PowerPoint.

• Pair once, then connect the HID keyboard in SlidePilot. A Bluetooth pairing label is not an HID connection.

• Next/Previous send Page Down/Page Up. Start sends F5; From current sends Shift+F5. End sends Escape. B toggles black screen during a slideshow.

• The laptop must keep PowerPoint focused. SlidePilot cannot read the current slide or black-screen state. Keyboard layout and PowerPoint settings can affect shortcuts.

• Leaving SlidePilot or locking your phone ends the session. Reopen, retry HID if needed, and connect again. The local timer continues until paused.

• Use one presenter at a time. Disconnect the previous phone before another classmate connects.

• TECNO, Realme and Infinix compatibility depends on the exact model and firmware. API 28+ alone is not a support guarantee.
No laptop names or addresses are logged. Copy includes phone model, Android version, and recent HID events. Nothing is uploaded.
Waiting for the previous HID session to finish cleanup…

Android did not confirm HID cleanup. Turn Bluetooth off and on while SlidePilot is open, then retry. If this persists, force-stop and reopen SlidePilot. A new registration has been blocked to avoid overlapping sessions.
The presentation will stop responding to your phone until you connect again.
